records.actionTitle: 7. Suicide Attempt
records.sourceSnippet: . 7. Suicide Attempt A self-injurious behavior for which there is evidence that the person had at least some intent to kill himself or herself. A suicide attempt may result in death, injuries, or no injuries. A mixture of ambivalent feelings such as wish to die and desire to live is a common experience with most suicide attempts. Therefore, ambivalence is not a sign of a less serious or less dangerous suicide attempt. -- 25 of 79 -- 4 270reg.doc REGULATION No. 270 – CONTINUED.
